title: A masjid prayer timetable (printed or on screen)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y3 lesson 79 (A masjid prayer timetable (printed or on screen))
intro: Lesson 79: Digital clocks, am and pm. To understand how to read 12-hour digital times with am and pm and match them to 24-hour times

questions.q: Write in 24-hour time: 10:05 am; 2:50 pm; 11:30 pm
Write in 12-hour time with am or pm: 17:25; 08:10; 21:00
In mid-June in London, Maghrib is at about 21:20. Is it light or dark at 8 pm? Explain.
questions.a: Still light: 8 pm is 20:00, before Maghrib at sunset

questions.q: 15:00 is... A) 3 pm B) 5 pm C) 3 am
Big question: how can 7:00 mean two times?
questions.a: 7 am in the morning and 7 pm in the evening; 24-hour time writes 07:00 and 19:00
